title: Add a subtract function and its test
bottom_line: The code change was cheap; most of the cost was **context, not work**: a 73K-token prompt re-read on all 15 calls, and a subagent that spent about 100K tokens to list one folder.

why.cause: `CLAUDE.md` is loaded on every call and has grown into a log of past decisions, most of which no task needs.
why.cost: Most of the 73K-token context, re-read on all 15 API calls of this task.
evidence: the context stood at 73K tokens when the review started, with only two small files read
`CLAUDE.md` holds 22 dated history entries and 9 current rules

what.change: Move the dated entries into `docs/HISTORY.md` and keep only the current rules in `CLAUDE.md`.
what.safe_because: No rule, gate or approval step changes, and the history stays one read away.
what.watch_for: A rule that only lived inside a history entry. Check that none of the moved entries says must or never.

actions.title: Run one-command jobs directly, not in a subagent

why.cause: A folder listing was handed to a subagent, which starts with a fresh context and has to cache it before doing anything.
why.cost: About 100K tokens, mostly cache writes, for a single `ls` in turn 4.
evidence: turn 4: one subagent, 2 API calls, 1 tool call
the subagent wrote 53K tokens to the cache before its only command

what.change: Add one line to the agent rules: use a subagent for multi-step research, not for single commands.
what.safe_because: Subagents stay available for the work they suit, and review roles are untouched.
what.watch_for: Long investigations squeezed into the main context. Keep subagents for anything over a few steps.

why.cause: `code-review` and `pr-review` describe the same request, so both are offered and their checklists disagree on missing tests.
why.cost: About 9K extra tokens in context whenever a review is asked for.
evidence: one says block on a missing test, the other calls it a suggestion

what.change: Keep `code-review`, and narrow `pr-review` to writing pull-request summaries.
what.safe_because: The review step and its blocking rule stay; only the duplicate checklist goes.
what.watch_for: A summary format you relied on disappearing.

actions.title: Outline first when asked to explain everything

why.cause: A request to explain every line produced a long answer that was stopped part-way.
why.cost: Small here: the tokens of the stopped answer bought nothing.
evidence: turn 6 was interrupted while the answer was being written

what.change: For explain-everything requests, give a short outline first and expand the parts asked for.
what.safe_because: Nothing is skipped; the detail is one reply away.
what.watch_for: Outlines too thin to be useful. Expand when asked.

skills.name: hello
skills.evidence: Used once by slash command in turn 2. Small and does one thing.

skills.name: code-review
skills.evidence: 71% description overlap; both are offered for review requests.

skills.name: tdd
skills.evidence: Says run only the failing test; `AGENTS.md` says run the full suite after every change. Both were loaded.

skills.name: subagent guidance
skills.evidence: Nothing tells the agent when a subagent is worth its start-up cost. See action 2.
